editMetrics.name: rmsPositionError
editMetrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||p_ref(t)-p_edit(t)||^2)) over all sampled strand points
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; measures average spatial deviation after editing.

editMetrics.name: silhouetteError
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; approximates screen-space outer contour change using the XZ projection.

editMetrics.name: clumpPreservationScore
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; rewards edits that preserve strand-group length structure.

editMetrics.name: rootLocalityScore
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; indicates how stable root positions stay after editing.

editMetrics.name: editLocalityScore
editMetrics.formula: 1 - editedStrandRatio, where a strand is edited when RMS strand delta > 0.01 * averageReferenceLength
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; estimates how much of the hairstyle remained untouched outside the intended region.

editMetrics.name: boundaryNaturalnessScore
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; compares nearby guide strands across UV-space boundaries to penalize visible discontinuities.

editMetrics.name: editedStrandRatio
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better when locality is important; reports the fraction of strands whose sampled deformation exceeds the edit threshold.

editMetrics.name: editToRunLatencyMilliseconds
editMetrics.formula: wall-clock milliseconds spent applying the edit stack and preparing runtime state
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; approximates interactive response time from edit commit to runtime-ready output.

runtimeMetrics.name: selectedClusterCount
runtimeMetrics.formula: number of active-set clusters selected under the current budget
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher generally means more corrective work scheduled this frame.

runtimeMetrics.name: selectedGuideCount
runtimeMetrics.formula: total guide strands promoted to full corrective simulation
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher means more of the hairstyle receives high-cost correction.

runtimeMetrics.name: estimatedFrameMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Predicted frame cost used for bounded-latency reasoning; lower is safer for the 16.67 ms budget.

runtimeMetrics.name: recommendedSolverIterations
runtimeMetrics.formula: budget-adapted iteration recommendation derived from the current budget scale
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher means the runtime can afford more local corrective iterations this frame.
